## Open findings

### High (3)

- `admin-app-bars-height-ignored` — **AdminApp** — The activity chart ignores its height and renders six times too tall — `client/admin/sections/OverviewSection.svelte:126`
- `admin-app-narrow-rail-buries-content` — **AdminApp** — Below 720px the sidebar fills the viewport and buries every section
- `admin-app-sticky-rail-scrolls-away` — **AdminApp** — The sticky nav scrolls out of view and cannot be reached again — `client/admin/components/AdminSidebarPanel.svelte:52`

### Med (9)

- `admin-app-active-link-not-announced` — **AdminApp** — The active nav item is invisible to assistive tech
- `admin-app-kpi-values-truncate` — **AdminApp** — KPI values truncate to a single digit and an ellipsis
- `admin-app-no-focus-ring` — **AdminApp** — The admin app has no focus ring of its own — `client/admin/admin.html:8`
- `admin-app-refreshed-label-frozen` — **AdminApp** — "last refreshed" freezes at the moment of the last render
- `admin-app-reminders-section-uncarded` — **AdminApp** — Reminders is the only section without the card frame its siblings use — `client/admin/sections/RemindersSection.svelte:72`
- `admin-app-scrollspy-root-unset` — **AdminApp** — The scroll spy watches the wrong scroll container
- `admin-app-sidebar-styled-twice` — **AdminApp** — The sidebar is styled by two stylesheets that interleave per property
- `admin-app-status-pill-hardcoded` — **AdminApp** — The status pill always reads "configured" — `client/admin/components/AdminTopBar.svelte:29`
- `plugins-inactive-copy-overclaims-approval` — **PluginsSection** — The ineligible-plugin sentence names approval as the remedy for six different states — `client/settings/lib/plugin-eligibility.ts:44`

### Low (7)

- `admin-app-duplicate-load-controls` — **AdminApp** — Two sections offer indistinguishable "user id" lookups, one of them unlabelled — `client/admin/sections/MemosSection.svelte:92`
- `admin-app-empty-state-undesigned` — **AdminApp** — The "Empty data" state is not actually empty
- `admin-app-hardcoded-px-spacing` — **AdminApp** — Shell spacing is hardcoded px beside an unused spacing scale
- `admin-app-quick-stat-tools-hardcoded` — **AdminApp** — A quick stat is hardcoded to an em dash — `client/admin/components/AdminSidebarPanel.svelte:40`
- `admin-app-spark-fixed-width` — **AdminApp** — The overview sparkline renders at a fixed 120px inside a 570px panel — `client/admin/sections/OverviewSection.svelte:122`
- `settings-app-focus-ring-scoped-to-grid` — **SettingsApp** — The focus ring's colour is a hardcoded literal instead of the accent token — `client/shared/tokens.css:39`
- `settings-app-jump-menu-ignores-collapse` — **SettingsApp** — Re-picking the jump menu's current section does nothing

## Deferred

- `repos-no-edit-capability` — **ReposSection** — A repository can only be added or deleted, never edited
- `settings-app-no-shared-type-scale` — **SettingsApp** — No shared type scale, so every component invents its own font sizes
